analysis.reason: 3거래일 연속 관망 판정 유지. RSI 26.0으로 과매도 구간 진입 지속. MACD 히스토그램 -4.1655로 악화되며 하락 추세 강화. ADX 39.5로 뚜렷한 추세 형성 중이나, -DI(51.7)가 +DI(7.7)를 크게 상회하며 하락 압력 우위. 현재가 $166.19는 볼린저밴드 하단 $165.68에 근접하며 지지선 $164.58에 대한 압박 증가.
analysis.reasonEn: The wait-and-see stance is maintained for the third consecutive trading day. RSI remains in oversold territory at 26.0. MACD histogram is worsening to -4.1655, reinforcing the downtrend. ADX at 39.5 indicates a clear trend, but the -DI (51.7) significantly outweighs the +DI (7.7), showing downward pressure dominance. The current price of $166.19 is approaching the lower Bollinger Band at $165.68, increasing pressure on the support level at $164.58.

analysis.weeklyConflictEn: Weekly RSI at 33.4 shows weakness, and the weekly MACD histogram at -6.2650 continues its bearish trend. This aligns with the daily oversold condition, but the trend strength is weaker on the weekly chart (ADX 21.6) compared to the daily (ADX 39.5). Daily indicators take precedence.
